correctness.rationale: The coordinate proof establishes V_D4=P and V_D4*=C/2 by showing that the support function of each candidate cell satisfies every lattice Voronoi inequality, while the shortest lattice vectors give exactly the displayed defining inequalities. Polarity gives C=(V_D4)*. The published Voronoi-cell proposition then gives reducedness of C with respect to D4* and completeness of C/2 with respect to D4*; scale invariance gives completeness of C. The exact-rational checker independently reconstructs both 24-vertex polytopes and verifies core finite identities.

value.rationale: The result answers an explicit existence question from the primary source with the canonical regular 24-cell, a natural non-simplex rather than an ad hoc construction. It also exposes a structural mechanism: a lattice whose Voronoi polar is a homothet of the dual-lattice Voronoi cell automatically yields a simultaneous reduced-complete example. The D4 identity provides the first concrete higher-dimensional origin-symmetric instance located in the checked literature.
